question: Will the S&P 500 finish the week of Mon 9 Nov 2026 higher than it finished the week before?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": The S&P 500’s official close on Friday 2026-11-13 is strictly higher than its official close on Friday 2026-11-06.
- "No": The 2026-11-13 close is equal to or lower than the 2026-11-06 close.

Clarifications:
- Use official daily closing levels, not intraday levels. If either Friday is a market holiday, use the last trading day before it in that week.
